breakdown: 爱(love)+情(feeling) — the feeling of love

examples.py: Zhè shì yí ge àiqíng gùshi.
Àiqíng bú shì shēnghuó de quánbù.
Zhè bù xiǎoshuō xiě de shì àiqíng.

breakdown: 安(settle)+排(line up) — settle things into a line

examples.en: The manager arranged for me to go on a business trip.
What are your plans for the weekend?

khmer: សុវត្ថិភាព
breakdown: 安(peaceful, safe)+全(complete) — completely at peace

khmer: ទាន់ពេលវេលា
breakdown: 按(according to)+时(time) — according to the time

examples.en: He always finishes homework on time.
The plane didn't take off on time.
You must take medicine on time.
We started the meeting on time.

breakdown: 按(press, follow)+照(follow, shine on) — following the given way

examples.en: Please do it according to the requirements.

examples.cn: 按照计划，我们明天出发。
examples.en: According to the plan, we leave tomorrow.
According to the rules, smoking isn't allowed.

examples.cn: 他按照说明修理了电视。
examples.py: Tā ànzhào shuōmíng xiūlǐ le diànshì.
examples.en: He fixed the TV following the instructions.

breakdown: 百(hundred)+分(part)+之(of) — parts of a hundred

examples.cn: 百分之八十的学生同意。

examples.en: The price dropped by ten percent.
I have one hundred percent confidence.

examples.cn: 百分之五十的人参加了。
examples.py: Bǎifēnzhī wǔshí de rén cānjiā le.
examples.en: Fifty percent of people took part.

examples.cn: 收入增加了百分之二十。

breakdown: 木(wood radical)+奉(sound fèng) — a wooden stick; slang for 'great'

examples.py: Zhè chǎng yǎnchū tài bàng le.

khmer: នំប៉ាវចំហុយ
breakdown: 包(wrap)+子(noun suffix) — dough wrapped around filling

examples.en: I eat baozi in the morning.

examples.py: Wǒ mǎi le liǎng ge bāozi.
Zhè jiā diàn de bāozi hěn yǒumíng.

breakdown: 保(keep safe, 亻person radical)+护(guard) — keeping and guarding

examples.cn: 这个密码保护我的信息。
examples.py: Zhège mìmǎ bǎohù wǒ de xìnxī.

breakdown: 保(keep)+证(prove) — keeping a proven promise

examples.en: I guarantee I'll finish on time.
He promised not to be late again.
The quality of this is guaranteed.

breakdown: 报(report)+名(name) — reporting your name

examples.en: I want to sign up for the competition.

examples.py: Yǐjīng yǒu yìbǎi rén bàomíng le.
examples.en: A hundred people have already signed up.
To register you must hand in a form.

english: to hug; to hold in arms
breakdown: 扌(hand radical)+包(wrap) — arms wrapping around

examples.py: Zhège xiāngzi tài zhòng, bào bu dòng.
examples.en: This box is too heavy to carry.

examples.py: Tā bào zhe yí shù huā.
examples.en: She is holding a bunch of flowers.

examples.py: Háizi kū le, kuài bàobao tā.
examples.en: The child is crying, hug him.

breakdown: 抱(hold)+歉(apology) — holding an apology

examples.py: Bàoqiàn, zhège wèizi yǒu rén le.
Wǒ wèi zhè jiàn shì xiàng nǐ bàoqiàn.
examples.en: I apologize to you for this.

breakdown: 亻(person radical)+咅 — used for multiplying amounts

examples.py: Zhège shì nàge de liǎng bèi.
Tā de shōurù shì wǒ de liǎng bèi.

examples.cn: 这个房间比那个大一倍。
examples.py: Zhège fángjiān bǐ nàge dà yí bèi.
examples.en: This room is twice as big as that one.

breakdown: 本(root, origin)+来(come) — where it came from originally

examples.cn: 我本来想去，可是下雨了。
examples.py: Wǒ běnlái xiǎng qù, kěshì xià yǔ le.
examples.en: I originally wanted to go, but it rained.

examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì běnlái hěn jiǎndān.
examples.en: This matter was originally very simple.

examples.cn: 我们本来的计划改变了。
examples.py: Wǒmen běnlái de jìhuà gǎibiàn le.

examples.en: It should have been this way from the start.

breakdown: 竹(bamboo radical)+本(root) — as stiff as a bamboo root

examples.py: Tā bú bèn, zhǐshì bú rènzhēn.
examples.en: He isn't stupid, just not serious.

examples.py: Zhè shì yí ge bèn bànfǎ.

examples.en: The slow bird starts flying early.

breakdown: 比(compare)+如(like) — comparing to something like it

examples.py: Wǒ xǐhuan yùndòng, bǐrú dǎ qiú.
examples.en: I like sports, for example playing ball.

examples.cn: 有很多水果，比如香蕉和葡萄。
examples.py: Yǒu hěn duō shuǐguǒ, bǐrú xiāngjiāo hé pútao.
examples.en: There is lots of fruit, for example bananas and grapes.

examples.py: Bǐrú zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng zěnme bàn?
examples.en: For example, what do you do in this situation?

examples.cn: 他会很多语言，比如中文。
examples.py: Tā huì hěn duō yǔyán, bǐrú Zhōngwén.
examples.en: He knows many languages, for example Chinese.

khmer: បញ្ចប់ការសិក្សា
breakdown: 毕(finish)+业(studies, work) — finishing your studies

examples.py: Bìyè yǐhòu nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme?
examples.en: What do you want to do after graduating?

examples.py: Wǒmen shì tóng yì nián bìyè de.

english: (measure word for times, from start to finish)
khmer: ដង (ពីដើមដល់ចប់)
breakdown: 辶(walking radical)+扁 — going through the whole thing once

examples.py: Zhè běn shū wǒ kàn le sān biàn.
examples.en: I read this book three times.

examples.py: Wǒ niàn le yí biàn kèwén.
examples.en: I read the text through once.

examples.py: Tīng yí biàn jiù míngbai le.

breakdown: 标(mark)+准(accurate) — the accurate mark to measure by

examples.py: Zhè shì yí ge gāo biāozhǔn.

khmer: ទម្រង់បែបបទ
breakdown: 表(surface, chart)+格(grid, box) — a chart of boxes

examples.en: The forms are in the office.
To register you must submit a form.

examples.py: Wǒ bǎ xìnxī tián zài biǎogé lǐ.
examples.en: I filled the information into the form.

khmer: បង្ហាញ / សម្ដែង
breakdown: 表(show outwardly)+示(show) — showing what is inside

examples.en: I want to express my thanks.

breakdown: 表(show)+演(act) — showing by acting

examples.en: What time does the performance start?

breakdown: 表(show)+扬(raise up) — raising someone up publicly

examples.py: Jīnglǐ biǎoyáng le tā de gōngzuò.

examples.en: Praise is more useful than criticism.
The child was happy to be praised.

breakdown: 饼(flat cake, 饣food radical)+干(dry) — a dry flat cake

examples.en: The biscuits are in the box.

examples.py: Háizi chī le sān kuài bǐnggān.

examples.cn: 我买了一盒巧克力饼干。
examples.py: Wǒ mǎi le yì hé qiǎokèlì bǐnggān.
examples.en: I bought a box of chocolate biscuits.

khmer: ហើយថែមទាំង
breakdown: 并(together)+且(also) — together and also

examples.cn: 这个方法简单并且有效。
examples.en: This method is simple and effective.

examples.py: Tā tóngyì le, bìngqiě hěn zhīchí.
examples.en: She agreed, and is very supportive.

examples.py: Wǒmen yào kuài, bìngqiě yào zhǔnquè.
examples.en: We need to be fast and accurate.

examples.cn: 他学习中文，并且学得很好。
examples.py: Tā xuéxí Zhōngwén, bìngqiě xué de hěn hǎo.
examples.en: He studies Chinese, and studies it well.

breakdown: 博(broad, learned)+士(scholar) — a broadly learned scholar

examples.en: I want to do a PhD.
She has a PhD in history.

examples.py: Dú bóshì yào hěn duō nián.

examples.en: After a master's comes a PhD.

english: to have no choice but to
khmer: ចាំបាច់ត្រូវតែ
breakdown: 不(not)+得(can)+不(not) — 'cannot not', so you must

examples.en: I had no choice but to agree.

examples.cn: 下雨了，我们不得不回家。
examples.py: Xià yǔ le, wǒmen bùdébù huí jiā.
examples.en: It rained, so we had to go home.

examples.cn: 他不得不放弃这个机会。
examples.en: He had to give up this chance.

examples.cn: 我不得不承认他是对的。
examples.py: Wǒ bùdébù chéngrèn tā shì duì de.
examples.en: I have to admit he is right.

examples.cn: 因为堵车，我们不得不迟到。
examples.en: Because of traffic, we had to be late.

breakdown: 不(not)+管(manage, control) — not controlled by it

examples.cn: 不管天气怎么样，我都去。
examples.py: Bùguǎn tiānqì zěnmeyàng, wǒ dōu qù.
examples.en: No matter the weather, I'll go.

examples.py: Bùguǎn duō nán, wǒ dōu yào shì.
examples.en: No matter how hard, I'll try.

examples.cn: 不管你说什么，他都不听。
examples.py: Bùguǎn nǐ shuō shénme, tā dōu bù tīng.
examples.en: No matter what you say, he won't listen.

examples.py: Bùguǎn shéi lái, dōu yào páiduì.
examples.en: No matter who comes, they must queue.

examples.cn: 不管结果如何，努力最重要。
examples.py: Bùguǎn jiéguǒ rúhé, nǔlì zuì zhòngyào.
examples.en: Whatever the result, effort matters most.

breakdown: 不(not)+过(pass, exceed) — nothing beyond that, so 'however'

examples.py: Zhège cài hǎochī, búguò tài guì.
examples.en: This dish is tasty, but too expensive.

examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù, búguò méi shíjiān.
examples.en: I want to go, but I have no time.

examples.py: Tā hěn lèi, búguò hái zài gōngzuò.
examples.en: He is tired, but still working.

examples.py: Búguò shì yí ge xiǎo wèntí.

examples.en: The weather is fine, but a bit cold.

khmer: មិនត្រឹមតែ
breakdown: 不(not)+仅(only) — not only this

examples.en: He is not only clever, but hardworking.

examples.py: Zhè bùjǐn shì wǒ de wèntí.

examples.cn: 她不仅会中文，还会法语。
examples.py: Tā bùjǐn huì Zhōngwén, hái huì Fǎyǔ.
examples.en: She knows not only Chinese but also French.

examples.cn: 不仅学生，老师也参加了。
examples.py: Bùjǐn xuésheng, lǎoshī yě cānjiā le.
examples.en: Not only students, teachers also took part.

examples.cn: 这不仅浪费钱，还浪费时间。
examples.py: Zhè bùjǐn làngfèi qián, hái làngfèi shíjiān.
examples.en: This wastes not only money but also time.

breakdown: 部(section)+分(divide) — a divided section

examples.py: Wǒ wánchéng le yí bùfen zuòyè.
examples.en: I finished part of my homework.
This part of the content is important.

examples.py: Qián de yí bùfen gěi le tā.
examples.en: Part of the money was given to him.

breakdown: 扌(hand radical)+察(examine) — a hand wiping carefully

examples.en: Wipe your face with a towel.
The window is dirty, it needs wiping.

breakdown: 犭(animal radical)+青 — guessing like an animal sensing something

examples.py: Wǒ cāi tā bú huì lái.

examples.en: This question is hard to guess.

examples.py: Bié cāi le, wǒ gàosu nǐ.

khmer: សម្ភារៈ / ឯកសារ
breakdown: 材(timber, 木wood radical)+料(material) — raw stuff to work with

examples.py: Shēnqǐng yào jiāo hěn duō cáiliào.

breakdown: 参(take part)+观(look at) — going in to look around

examples.en: We're going to visit the museum.
Visiting time is in the morning.

khmer: អាហារដ្ឋាន
breakdown: 餐(meal)+厅(hall) — a hall for meals

examples.en: The school dining hall is big.
What time does the restaurant close?

examples.py: Wǒ zài cāntīng yùdìng le zuòwèi.
examples.en: I reserved a seat at the restaurant.

breakdown: 厕(toilet)+所(place) — the toilet place

examples.en: The toilet is on the second floor.

khmer: ស្ទើរតែដូចគ្នា
breakdown: 差(differ)+不多(not much) — not much difference

examples.en: These two are about the same.

examples.py: Tā de shuǐpíng hé wǒ chàbuduō.
examples.en: His level is about the same as mine.

breakdown: 长(long)+城(city wall) — the long wall

examples.en: I want to go see the Great Wall.
The Great Wall is extremely long.

examples.cn: 长城是中国有名的地方。
examples.py: Chángchéng shì Zhōngguó yǒumíng de dìfang.
examples.en: The Great Wall is a famous place in China.

examples.cn: 我们在长城照了很多照片。
examples.py: Wǒmen zài Chángchéng zhào le hěn duō zhàopiàn.
examples.en: We took many photos at the Great Wall.
Climbing the Great Wall is tiring.

khmer: ទន្លេឆាងជាំង
breakdown: 长(long)+江(large river) — the long river

examples.py: Chángjiāng shì Zhōngguó zuì cháng de hé.
examples.en: The Yangtze is China's longest river.
I toured the Yangtze by boat.
The Yangtze is in the south.

examples.py: Chángjiāng hé Huánghé dōu hěn yǒumíng.
examples.en: Both the Yangtze and Yellow River are famous.
The scenery of the Yangtze is beautiful.

khmer: ទីលាន / លើក
breakdown: 土(earth radical)+carrying sound — an open piece of ground

examples.py: Xià le yì chǎng dà yǔ.

breakdown: 超(surpass)+过(pass) — passing beyond

examples.en: The number of people exceeded one hundred.

examples.py: Tā de chéngjì chāoguò le wǒ.
Jiàgé chāoguò le wǒ de yùsuàn.
Děng le chāoguò yí ge xiǎoshí.

breakdown: 成(become, accomplish)+功(achievement) — achieving what you set out to do

examples.en: Only through effort can you succeed.

breakdown: 成(become)+为(be) — turning into something

examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng chéngwéi yì míng yīshēng.
examples.en: I want to become a doctor.

examples.py: Tā chéngwéi le wǒ de hǎo péngyou.

examples.cn: 这里成为了有名的地方。
examples.py: Zhèlǐ chéngwéi le yǒumíng de dìfang.
Tā chéngwéi le yì míng lǜshī.

examples.cn: 努力才能成为更好的人。
examples.py: Nǔlì cái néng chéngwéi gèng hǎo de rén.
examples.en: Only by trying can you become a better person.

khmer: ស្មោះត្រង់
breakdown: 诚(sincere, 讠speech radical)+实(real) — speaking what is real

examples.py: Tā shì yí ge chéngshí de rén.

examples.cn: 我相信他，因为他很诚实。
examples.py: Wǒ xiāngxìn tā, yīnwèi tā hěn chéngshí.
examples.en: I trust him because he is honest.
You should be honest as a person.

breakdown: 乘(ride)+坐(sit) — sitting and riding

examples.en: I travel to Beijing by plane.
Please mind your safety when riding.

khmer: ភ្ញាក់ផ្អើល
breakdown: 吃(eat, take in)+惊(startled) — taking in a shock

examples.py: Tā chījīng de kàn zhe wǒ.
examples.en: He looked at me in surprise.

examples.py: Tā de chéngjì ràng lǎoshī chījīng.

khmer: ម្ដងទៀត / ជាថ្មី
breakdown: 重(again, repeat)+新(new) — doing it new again

examples.en: This form must be filled in again.

breakdown: 抽(draw out, pull)+烟(smoke) — drawing in smoke

examples.en: Smoking is bad for your health.

examples.py: Tā juédìng bú zài chōuyān le.
